visual_elements.description: A large '=' sign placed between the filter stack and the output cube, indicating the 5 filters produce the depth-5 output volume.

visual_elements.description: Handwritten-style black question 'How many weights for these 5 neurons?' with the answer directly below in red: '5 · 7 · 7 · 3 = 735' (5 filters times 7x7 spatial size times 3 input channels equals 735 weights).
